site.name: Ball Mountain
overview: Ball Mountain is an inactive historic mine east of Leadville in Lake County, recorded for lead with silver, zinc, and gold also associated.

timeline.text: Engineering and Mining Journal reported that work by the Ball Mountain Tunnel Company was to resume on the property under M. P. Murray.

moreHistory: The mapped point identifies the historic Ball Mountain mine locality and should not be treated as evidence of current public access or safe entry to mine workings.
